ValidationRule.description: Validates that IRA contributions do not exceed the annual IRS limit of $7,000 (or $8,000 with catch-up)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(TEXT(Plan_Type__c) = "Traditional IRA", TEXT(Plan_Type__c) = "Roth IRA"), OR( AND(Catch_Up_Eligible__c = false, Employee_Contributions_YTD__c > 7000), AND(Catch_Up_Eligible__c = true, Employee_Contributions_YTD__c > 8000) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: IRA contribution exceeds annual IRS limit. For 2024: $7,000 (standard) or $8,000 (with catch-up for age 50+)
